data.content_ref: inline:The target conflates error signature similarity with causal correlation, a methodological flaw. A shared external cause (e.g., a network outage) can produce DIFFERENT error signatures across heterogeneous stacks (one service reports DNS resolution failure, another reports connection timeout), appearing as 'high Error Signature Diversity' and falsely classifying a correlated failure as independent. Conversely, independent failures of homogeneous components can produce identical signatures (e.g., independent OOM kills). The proposed distinguishing evidence is thus neither necessary nor sufficient for identifying shared causes.
